lines.trans: Charlotte, how are you since this accident?
It is awful, I slipped outside.
How did you manage to slip?
I slipped on a banana peel!
But that only happens in cartoons!
A real nuisance, these banana peels!
I have a great idea for the film.
Your character will have telekinesis powers!
Oscar, that is truly not believable.
We must speak to each other frankly.
You are right, this shoot was absurd.
I am preparing a beautiful animated film now.
Do you want to be my heroine's voice?
